notes: Tracer scale 18.21 is about 35% too high; six rooms on two levels agree on 13.4-13.6 px/ft (median of the 12 side values 13.53). Bedroom 3 and Bedroom 4 are printed with the vertical side first (13'-7" and 13'-6" are the heights; Bedroom 4 height is to the closet front wall, which the tracer missed, so span overshot and rulers were used; span also ran through its west wall). Garage width span returned None (door side untraced), height is from span, width from crop rulers; garage has a small notch at lower left but full extents are clear. Loft (13' x 14'-6") was left out of the scale because of its ladder nook: rulers give 171 x 193 px below the nook = 13.15 / 13.31 px/ft, slightly low but consistent, so all three levels are drawn at the same scale. Overall dimensions 79' and 54'-6" are printed loose near (1500,1180) with no extension lines; rough overview extents (about 1069 px wide, 732 px deep on the main level) give 13.5 and 13.4 px/ft, supporting the result but not used. Missing walls are mostly window walls and the garage door side (great room west and south-west, loft west end, owner's bath east), plus the Bedroom 4 closet front and west wall; loft and owner's bath rectangles were located from the overview only (approximate). No clear extra walls seen: fireplace/chimney boxes and the lower-level foundation outlines are drawn as real walls.
